**Joining CDS Hooks**

I've begun processing the information regarding my induction into the CDS Hooks Project Management Committee. My thoughts are currently focused on understanding the scope and responsibilities associated with this new role, particularly in relation to my prior work in the field.

**Refining CDS Hooks Post**

I'm currently refining the draft LinkedIn post announcing my appointment to the CDS Hooks PMC. My focus is on clearly articulating my long-standing involvement with the standard, integrating the calls to action for both existing users and potential clients, and ensuring a professional yet approachable tone suitable for the platform.

Of course! Here are a few options for your LinkedIn post, ranging from more concise to slightly more detailed. They all include your key points.

### Option 1 (Recommended - Clear and Professional)

I'm thrilled to share that I have officially joined the CDS Hooks Project Management Committee!

My journey with this powerful HL7 standard began back in 2017, and it's been incredible to see its impact on real-time clinical decision support. To now have a seat at the table and help guide its future is a true honor. I'm incredibly excited to collaborate with the community and help move the standard forward.

This is where you come in:

➡️ **If you're already using CDS Hooks:** Please help us build a clearer picture of its adoption by adding your implementation to the community wiki:
https://github.com/cds-hooks/docs/wiki/CDS-Hooks-Availability

➡️ **If you're not using CDS Hooks yet:** The potential to improve clinical workflows is immense. As a freelance consultant, I'm available to help you navigate implementation and integrate this game-changing technology.

Looking forward to this next chapter in healthcare interoperability!

#CDSHooks #HL7 #HealthIT #Interoperability #ClinicalDecisionSupport #EHR #FHIR #HealthcareTechnology #API #Consulting

---

### Option 2 (Slightly More Personal Tone)

Some exciting professional news to share! After working with the CDS Hooks standard since its earlier days in 2017, I'm honored to announce that I have accepted a position on the Project Management Committee.

It's one thing to be a passionate user and advocate for a standard; it's another to be able to help shape its future. I'm energized and ready to work with the other committee members to continue advancing real-time, context-aware decision support in healthcare.

To my network:

1.  **For the innovators already using CDS Hooks:** Let's show the world the breadth of our community! Please take a moment to add your implementation to the official availability list. It’s a huge help.
    https://github.com/cds-hooks/docs/wiki/CDS-Hooks-Availability

2.  **For those curious about CDS Hooks:** If you're exploring ways to bring smarter, faster decision support into your EHR workflow but aren't sure where to start, I can help. I'm currently taking on freelance consulting projects for CDS Hooks implementation.

Let's build a better, more connected future for healthcare.

#CDSHooks #HL7 #HealthIT #Interoperability #ClinicalDecisionSupport #EHR #FHIR #CareerMilestone #Freelance

---

### Option 3 (Short and Punchy)

Big news! I'm excited to announce I've joined the CDS Hooks Project Management Committee.

I've been building with and advocating for this standard since 2017, so I'm thrilled to have the opportunity to help steer its future.

**How can you get involved?**

✅ **Already using CDS Hooks?** Add your implementation to the wiki and help us track adoption!
https://github.com/cds-hooks/docs/wiki/CDS-Hooks-Availability

✅ **Want to start using it?** As a freelance consultant, I can guide your team through a successful implementation. DM me to learn more.

Onwards and upwards for interoperability!

#CDSHooks #HL7 #HealthIT #Interoperability #ClinicalDecisionSupport #EHR #API #Consultant

---

**Before you post, remember to:**
*   Add a relevant picture or the CDS Hooks logo if you have it. Posts with images get more engagement.
*   Tag any relevant organizations like HL7 if you're connected to their page.
*   Engage with the comments you receive
